title: 註冊 API endpoint (後端)
acceptance: POST /api/auth/register accepts: nameZh, nameEn, email, password, phone, idDocNumber, iaLicense?, organization?
Password hashed with bcrypt (10 rounds) before storage
Zod validation on all inputs (email format, required fields, password min 8 chars)
Returns 201 with { success: true } on success (no auto-login)
Rate limiting: 3 attempts per IP per 15 min
verification: POST /api/auth/register with valid body → 201. Duplicate email → 409. Missing fields → 400.
